title: How Channel Corporation modernized their architecture with Amazon DynamoDB, Part 3: User and Badge
text: Channel Corporation shares how they split their all-purpose Amazon DynamoDB User table into role-specific tables, moving Badge data into a dedicated UserBadge table to stop transaction-conflict throttling and GSI back pressure, and how they ran a zero-downtime online migration using DynamoDB Export and Import with Amazon S3 and AWS Glue.
